description: Source code for a Python class 'GeminiFileAPI' that provides methods to interact with Google's Gemini File API, including uploading, retrieving, listing, and deleting files. The class handles resumable uploads, file metadata, and API communication.

classes.name: GeminiFileAPI
classes.description: Client class for managing files via Google's Gemini File API, supporting upload, fetch, list, and delete operations.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the GeminiFileAPI client with API key and base URL.

methods.name: upload_file
methods.description: Uploads a file to the Gemini File API using resumable upload protocol.

methods.name: get_file
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specified file.

methods.name: list_files
methods.description: Lists uploaded files with pagination support.

methods.name: delete_file
methods.description: Deletes a specified file from the API.
